svg.title: MTD300P20 diblock copolymer
svg.desc: Source describes a phosphine-functionalized diblock copolymer, [methyltetracyclododecene]300-[norbornene-CH2O(CH2)5P(oct)2]20, used in the separate THF-based SAXS-film procedure. Printed block counts and substituent notation are preserved; stereochemistry, sequence, end groups and an exact finite molecular graph are unresolved. No computed polymer conformation is invented.
